description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a DTV (Digital TV) plugin class within the WPEFramework. It contains methods for initialization, deinitialization, and various remote procedure calls (RPC) related to managing digital TV services, such as retrieving channel lists, starting/stopping playback, and configuring tuner parameters.

classes.name: DTV
classes.description: Implements a digital TV plugin with RPC methods for service management, configuration, and playback control within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DTV plugin, sets up communication with the underlying IDTV interface, and registers properties and methods.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications and RPC endpoints, and releases references.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information, currently a placeholder.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers RPC properties and methods for version 1 and 2 of the API.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all RPC properties and methods.

methods.name: GetNumberOfCountries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of supported countries.

methods.name: GetCountryList
methods.description: Gets the list of available countries.

methods.name: GetCountry
methods.description: Gets the current country setting.

methods.name: SetCountry
methods.description: Sets the current country.

methods.name: GetLnbList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of LNB configurations.

methods.name: GetSatelliteList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of satellites.

methods.name: GetNumberOfServices
methods.description: Returns the number of available services.

methods.name: GetServiceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of services based on a given index or tuner type.

methods.name: GetNowNextEvents
methods.description: Gets current and upcoming events for a specific service URI.

methods.name: GetScheduleEvents
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled events within a time range.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Provides status information for a specific connection handle.

methods.name: GetServiceInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed info about a specific service identified by a triplet.

methods.name: GetServiceComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components (video/audio/subtitle) for a specified service.

methods.name: GetTransportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves transport stream info for specified transport IDs.

methods.name: GetExtendedEventInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed extended information for an event.

methods.name: GetSignalInfo
methods.description: Gets signal quality and lock status for a given handle.

methods.name: AddLnb
methods.description: Adds a new LNB configuration.

methods.name: AddSatellite
methods.description: Adds a new satellite configuration.

methods.name: StartServiceSearch
methods.description: Starts a service search with specified parameters.

methods.name: FinishServiceSearch
methods.description: Completes an ongoing service search.

methods.name: StartPlaying
methods.description: Begins playback of a service or stream.

methods.name: StopPlaying
methods.description: Stops playback of a service or stream.
